mentions.name: Church AV Setup Documentation Site
mentions.description: A small static site documenting the AV setup at a church, started as an HTML page with buttons for shortcuts and expanded with written notes. It is built with the Zola static site generator, which takes Markdown files as content and renders them into template HTML files.
mentions.problem: Writing HTML by hand was tedious and there were surprisingly few simple WYSIWYG desktop HTML editors, so the site is built from Markdown content through a static site generator instead.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Making a little static site to document the AV setup at my church.

Started with just an html page with buttons for shortcuts.
